titre: Audience de la NFL par diffuseur
sous_titre: Millions de téléspectateurs par match, saison régulière 2025

NBC.texte: averaged 23.5 million viewers for Sunday Night Football (SNF) games across its linear channels and the Peacock streaming service

CBS.texte: increased its average game audience by 11 per cent YoY to 21.25 million viewers

Fox.texte: averaged 19.6 million viewers for all of its games, which was a YoY gain of six per cent

ESPN.texte: Monday Night Football (MNF) averaged 15.8 million viewers

Prime Video.texte: recorded its best viewership for Thursday Night Football (TNF), averaging 15.33 million viewers for the season
